purpose: Durable registry of active Codex-driven Slack operating loops for the FrankX / Arcanea / Starlight portfolio.
globalGates: No production deploy or promotion without approval
No merge to main without approval
No spending or vendor activation without approval
No customer or partner messages without approval
No Hermes gateway activation without verified credentials, routing, and machine health

automations.job: Prepare the full multi-brand action loop and notify only when useful.
Post the daily executive digest: outcomes, blockers, decisions, repo/site risks, brand signals, and execution queue.
Report known domains, subdomains, site ownership, GitHub/Vercel movement, inspect links, and deployment/domain risks.
Run read-only repo risk sweep across flagship and now-priority repos.
Produce recording briefs, social variants, image/carousel specs, and approval packets.
Produce or improve one high-quality LinkedIn/Instagram carousel candidate from current AI-lab signals, brand strategy, portfolio context, and prior learning.
learningInputs: official AI lab/product updates when topical claims are made

automations.job: Detect stale anchors, missing proof, waiting approvals, missing handoffs, and naming drift.
Weekly portfolio review: shipped proof, business movement, repo/domain movement, content, approvals, and what to keep, merge, park, or archive.
Create private weekly estate ledger and visual constellation.

validationPlan: Check that the first digest posts to #daily-report.
Check that repo and domain reports post to #repo-command.
Confirm read-only automations do not stage, commit, push, deploy, or mutate public state.
Confirm content automation prepares #social-approvals packets without publishing.
Confirm carousel factory records learning from approvals, performance, design QA, and brand guides.
Use weekly review to cut or park channels and loops that do not produce proof.
